title: Agentic coding notes from Galapagos Island
summary: Software engineer Dan Luu published an in-depth analysis detailing his hands-on experience using autonomous agentic AI loops for iterative code generation, testing, and debugging. The report documents how current agentic frameworks handle boilerplates and prototyping, while highlighting major obstacles such as state tracking across long contexts and error propagation where agents become trapped in infinite loops. This analysis underscores that while AI agents accelerate standard tasks, human guidance remains necessary to validate architectural logic and correct systemic deviations. (source: https://danluu.com/ai-coding/#appendix-agentic-loops-and-writing-this-post)
title_cn: 来自加拉帕戈斯群岛的 Agentic 编码笔记
summary_cn: 软件工程师 Dan Luu 发表了一份深度分析，详细介绍了他在迭代代码生成、测试和调试中使用自主 Agentic AI 循环的实践经验。该报告记录了当前的 Agentic 框架如何处理样板代码和原型设计，同时强调了主要障碍，例如跨长上下文的状态跟踪问题，以及 AI 代理陷入无限循环的错误传播问题。这份分析表明，虽然 AI 代理可以加速标准任务，但人类的指导对于验证架构逻辑和纠正系统偏差仍然是必不可少的。

title: Potential session/cache leakage between workspace instances or consumer accounts
summary: A potential security vulnerability has been identified and reported within the Anthropic Claude Code developer command-line assistant repository. The issue reports risks associated with stateful data, authentication sessions, or cached memory crossing security boundaries and leaking between distinct workspace instances or consumer accounts. This highlights a critical isolation and data governance vulnerability inside developer-focused LLM tooling, which requires runtime isolation and cryptographic session separation to prevent unauthorized context leakage. (source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/74066)
title_cn: 工作空间实例或消费者账户之间可能存在会话/缓存泄露
summary_cn: 在 Anthropic Claude Code 开发者命令行助手存储库中发现并报告了一个潜在的安全漏洞。该问题指出与有状态数据、身份验证会话或缓存内存相关的风险，这些信息可能会跨越安全边界，在不同的工作空间实例或消费者账户之间泄露。这凸显了开发者专用 LLM 工具内部在隔离性和数据治理方面存在的重大安全漏洞，需要运行时隔离和加密会话分离，以防止未经授权的上下文泄露。

title: Google Books (or similar) all book scans – $200k bounty (2025)
summary: Anna's Archive has announced a $200,000 bounty program for the year 2025 to acquire comprehensive book scans from major digital repositories like Google Books. This crowdsourcing initiative aims to compile high-quality, large-scale digital text corpora for cultural preservation and training foundation language models. The campaign underscores the rising industry demand for massive datasets required to train linguistic reasoning architectures. (source: https://software.annas-archive.gl/AnnaArchivist/annas-archive/-/work_items/234)
title_cn: Google Books（或类似资源）全书扫描件——20 万美元悬赏 (2025)
summary_cn: Anna's Archive 宣布了一项 2025 年价值 20 万美元的悬赏计划，旨在从 Google Books 等大型数字知识库获取全面的书籍扫描件。这一众包计划旨在整理高质量、大规模的数字文本语料库，用于文化保护和基础语言模型的训练。该活动凸显了工业界对训练语言推理架构所需海量数据集日益增长的需求。

title: Fable created novel 4D splat format
summary: Fable has announced a novel 4D splat format that expands on standard 3D Gaussian Splatting techniques to capture dynamic spatial data. By introducing a temporal fourth dimension, this format facilitates high-fidelity, real-time rendering of moving scenes and volumetric video with minimal computational overhead. The technology represents a notable advancement for virtual reality, gaming, and computer vision fields seeking to bridge static reconstructions with fully dynamic generative environments. (source: https://adamraudonis.github.io/splats4D/)
title_cn: Fable 创建了新型 4D Splat 格式
summary_cn: Fable 宣布了一种新型 4D Splat 格式，它在标准 3D Gaussian Splatting 技术的基础上进行了扩展，以捕捉动态空间数据。通过引入第四个维度（时间），该格式能够以极低的计算开销实现动态场景和体积视频的高保真、实时渲染。这项技术代表了虚拟现实、游戏和计算机视觉领域的一项显著进步，旨在弥合静态重构与完全动态生成环境之间的差距。

title: Plein Air
summary: The Plein Air digital installation has showcased a new real-time generative art pipeline that translates organic environmental data into algorithmic visual renderings. Inspired by traditional French outdoor painting, the system processes continuous environmental data streams to generate dynamic visual landscapes that shift with simulated atmospheric and light changes. The project demonstrates a unique intersection of graphic frameworks, physical sensory inputs, and generative computer aesthetics. (source: https://art.joonas.wtf/)
summary_cn: Plein Air 数字装置展示了一种全新的实时生成艺术管道，可将有机环境数据转化为算法视觉渲染效果。受传统法国户外绘画的启发，该系统处理连续的环境数据流，以生成随模拟大气和光线变化而改变的动态视觉景观。该项目展示了图形框架、物理传感器输入和生成计算机美学之间独特的交集。

title: State of the Art Models Exhibit Regression in Schema Enforcement for Tool Calls
summary: Developer Armin Ronacher reported a performance regression in tool-calling reliability when testing advanced Anthropic models, specifically Claude Opus 4.8 and Sonnet 5, within the Pi application. While older Anthropic models successfully adhered to nested tool schemas, these newer models frequently generated non-existent arguments inside nested edit arrays, violating strict schema constraints. This behavior highlights ongoing challenges in how frontier models serialize structured inputs and adhere to developer-defined constraints, pointing to a potential need for sampler-level grammar-aware decoding rather than relying purely on model reasoning. (source: https://lucumr.pocoo.org/2026/7/4/better-models-worse-tools/)
title_cn: 顶尖模型在工具调用模式执行方面出现退化
summary_cn: 开发者 Armin Ronacher 报告称，在 Pi 应用程序中测试先进的 Anthropic 模型（特别是 Claude Opus 4.8 和 Sonnet 5）时，工具调用可靠性出现了性能退化。虽然旧的 Anthropic 模型能成功遵循嵌套工具模式，但这些较新的模型经常在嵌套编辑数组内生成不存在的参数，从而违反了严格的模式约束。这种行为凸显了前沿模型在序列化结构化输入和遵守开发者定义的约束方面面临的持续挑战，并指出可能需要采样层级的语法感知解码，而非完全依赖模型的推理能力。

title: Fable 5 System Card Documentation Released for Public Review
summary: Thomas Wolf has highlighted the release of the Fable 5 System Card, offering detailed documentation for the advanced artificial intelligence model. This technical document details the model's architecture, safety guidelines, and operational capabilities to promote transparency within the AI community. By publishing this card, the project enables developers and researchers to evaluate the model's performance limits, technical foundations, and safety boundaries to facilitate safer integration and broader adoption. (source: https://x.com/Thom_Wolf/status/2073350943886758318)
title_cn: Fable 5 系统卡文档发布以供公众评审
summary_cn: Thomas Wolf 强调了 Fable 5 系统卡的发布，为这一先进的人工智能模型提供了详细文档。这份技术文档详细说明了模型的架构、安全指南和操作能力，以提升 AI 社区内的透明度。通过发布该文档，该项目使开发者和研究人员能够评估模型的性能限制、技术基础和安全边界，从而促进更安全的集成和更广泛的采用。

title: Luma Labs Releases Ray 3.2 For Advanced Vision Capabilities
summary: Luma Labs has announced the release of Ray 3.2, a significant update to their vision-focused artificial intelligence suite. The new model update integrates advanced architecture to optimize multimodal interactions and high-fidelity video generation. Designed to bypass traditional trial-and-error workflows, Ray 3.2 delivers streamlined, precise control over generative outputs to improve efficiency in media production pipelines and visual storytelling applications. (source: https://x.com/LumaLabsAI/status/2073211416044069225)
title_cn: Luma Labs 发布 Ray 3.2，增强视觉功能
summary_cn: Luma Labs 宣布发布 Ray 3.2，这是其以视觉为核心的人工智能套件的重大更新。新的模型更新集成了先进架构，以优化多模态交互和高保真视频生成。Ray 3.2 旨在绕过传统的反复试验工作流，提供对生成输出的精简、精确控制，从而提高媒体制作管道和视觉叙事应用的效率。

title: Kling AI Hosts NextGen Campus Awards Ceremony For Creative Video Talent
summary: Kling AI has announced its NextGen Awards Ceremony, celebrating emerging student and early-stage filmmakers who leverage generative video technology. The event highlights how creators use Kling AI tools to produce high-fidelity 4K video content from experimental conceptual designs. By showcasing these student productions, Kling AI demonstrates the growing integration of accessible generative video tools into academic and independent cinematic workflows. (source: https://x.com/Kling_ai/status/2073240591463223578)
title_cn: Kling AI 举办 NextGen 校园奖颁奖典礼，嘉奖创意视频人才
summary_cn: Kling AI 宣布举办 NextGen 颁奖典礼，旨在庆祝那些利用生成式视频技术的杰出学生和早期电影制片人。该活动突显了创作者如何使用 Kling AI 工具将实验性的概念设计转化为高质量的 4K 视频内容。通过展示这些学生作品，Kling AI 展示了可访问的生成视频工具在学术和独立电影工作流中日益深化的融合。
